about.title: About
about.body: Hi, I'm Cheyla! I'm a bilingual motherhood, family, and lifestyle creator and mom of three, based in Pennsylvania. I turn everyday moments into relatable, engaging content, blending authentic storytelling with polished visuals — content that feels natural, builds trust, and helps brands connect with real families and everyday consumers. From motherhood and home to beauty, wellness, food, and travel, what I create feels warm, elevated, and genuinely me.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.meta_description: Privacy Policy for cheylajtavarez.com: what information the site collects, how it is used, your rights under GDPR, California, and Utah law, and our one-year data retention rule.
pages.body:
Last updated: November 1, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains what information cheylajtavarez.com (the "Site") collects, how it is used, and the choices you have. The Site is the personal brand and portfolio website of Cheyla J Tavarez ("we," "us," or "our"). By using the Site, you agree to this policy.

Information we collect

  • Information you send us. When you use the contact form or email us, we receive your name, your email address, and the contents of your message.
  • Basic technical information. Like most websites, the Site automatically receives limited technical data when you visit, such as the pages you view, your approximate location (country or region), your browser and device type, and the site that referred you. We use Cloudflare Web Analytics to understand overall traffic; it provides aggregate statistics and does not use cookies to track individual visitors across sites.
  • What we do not collect. The Site has no user accounts, no store, no comment sections, and no newsletter signup. We do not ask for or store passwords, payment information, or government identifiers.

How we use information

  • To respond to inquiries, including brand partnership and collaboration requests.
  • To operate, maintain, and improve the Site.
  • To protect the Site against spam, abuse, and security incidents.

How information is shared

  • We do not sell your personal information.
  • We share information only with the service providers that make the Site work: Cloudflare (website hosting and analytics) and Web3Forms (delivers contact form messages to our inbox). These providers process information only to provide their services.
  • We may disclose information if required by law or to protect our rights and safety.

Cookies

The Site uses only cookies that are strictly necessary for it to work and stay secure. Cloudflare, our hosting provider, may set a strictly necessary security cookie for that purpose. Our analytics are cookieless, and we do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. If we ever add optional cookies, they will run only after you accept them in the cookie banner shown on the Site. You can change your choice at any time using the Cookie Choices link in the footer.

Your choices and rights

You may ask us at any time to see the personal information we hold about you, to correct it, or to delete it. Email support@cheylajtavarez.com and we will respond within 30 days. Deletion requests are honored in full, subject to any legal obligation that requires us to keep a specific record.

Privacy rights where you live

European Union, EEA, and United Kingdom (GDPR). We process the information described above to respond to your inquiries and to operate this Site, on the basis of your consent and our legitimate interest in running the Site. You have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or receive a copy of your information, and to object to its processing. You may also complain to your local data protection authority.

California (CCPA, as amended by the CPRA). California residents have the right to know what personal information we hold about them, to ask for its deletion or correction, and not to be discriminated against for using these rights. We do not sell or share personal information, as those terms are defined in California law.

Utah (Utah Consumer Privacy Act) and other U.S. states. You have the right to confirm whether we hold your personal information, to access it, to ask for its deletion, and to obtain a copy. We do not sell personal information and do not use it for targeted advertising.

To use any of these rights, email support@cheylajtavarez.com. We will respond within the period required by the law that applies to you.

Data retention and destruction

We keep personal information, such as contact form messages and emails, for no longer than one (1) year. When the retention period ends, the information is fully and permanently destroyed as described in our Data Retention Policy.

Children

The Site is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.

Security

The Site is served over HTTPS, and access to the information we receive is limited to the site owner. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your information.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Changes take effect when posted on this page, with a new "Last updated" date.

Contact

Questions about this policy: support@cheylajtavarez.com

pages.title: Data Retention Policy
pages.meta_description: Data Retention Policy for cheylajtavarez.com: personal information is kept no longer than one year, then fully and permanently destroyed.
pages.body:
Last updated: November 1, 2026

This policy describes how long cheylajtavarez.com keeps personal information and how that information is destroyed when the retention period ends.

What this policy covers

Personal information received through the Site, including:

  • Contact form submissions (name, email address, and message).
  • Emails sent to us, including brand partnership and collaboration inquiries.
  • Any files or details you send us in connection with an inquiry.

Retention period: one year

We retain the information above for no longer than one (1) year from the date we receive it, or from our last communication with you about the same matter, whichever is later. Information that is part of an ongoing business relationship or a legal obligation may be kept only for as long as that relationship or obligation requires, and no longer.

Full destruction of data

When the retention period ends, the information is fully and permanently destroyed:

  • Emails and messages are deleted from the inbox and from trash or deleted-items folders, so they cannot be recovered.
  • Contact form records held by our form delivery provider are deleted.
  • Any downloaded files containing the information are permanently deleted, and digital copies are erased so the data cannot be reconstructed.
  • No archive copies, backups, or duplicates of the destroyed information are retained, except where a specific law requires otherwise. If a legal exception applies, the information is kept only as long as the law requires and is destroyed as soon as that period ends.

Annual review

At least once a year, we review the information we hold and destroy everything that has passed the one-year retention period.

Early deletion on request

You do not have to wait a year. You may request deletion of your information at any time by emailing support@cheylajtavarez.com, and it will be fully destroyed as described above, subject to any legal obligation.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Changes take effect when posted on this page, with a new "Last updated" date.

Contact

Questions about this policy: support@cheylajtavarez.com
